measurements.evidence_quote: Our analysis of the microparticle zeta potential revealed all microparticles to be negatively charged (between -30 and -45 mV). || The microparticle size distribution and zeta potential are reported in Fig. 5A and B, respectively. || Microparticle samples were suspended in de-ionized water (1 mg mL-1) and the zeta potential was analyzed (Zetasizer nano317, Malvern, UK).
measurements.evidence_location: Results, Fig. 5B; Methods, Microparticle zeta potential quantification
